blocks.source: Canto XXX
blocks.translation: Canto XXX

blocks.source: Nel tempo che Iunone era crucciata
blocks.translation: ’Twas at the time when Juno was enraged,

blocks.source: per Semelè contra ’l sangue tebano,
blocks.translation: For Semele, against the Theban blood,

blocks.source: come mostrò una e altra fïata,
blocks.translation: As she already more than once had shown,

blocks.source: Atamante divenne tanto insano,
blocks.translation: So reft of reason Athamas became,

blocks.source: che veggendo la moglie con due figli
blocks.translation: That, seeing his own wife with children twain

blocks.source: andar carcata da ciascuna mano,
blocks.translation: Walking encumbered upon either hand,

blocks.source: gridò: «Tendiam le reti, sì ch’io pigli
blocks.translation: He cried: “Spread out the nets, that I may take

blocks.source: la leonessa e ’ leoncini al varco»;
blocks.translation: The lioness and her whelps upon the passage;”

blocks.source: e poi distese i dispietati artigli,
blocks.translation: And then extended his unpitying claws,

blocks.source: prendendo l’un ch’avea nome Learco,
blocks.translation: Seizing the first, who had the name Learchus,

blocks.source: e rotollo e percosselo ad un sasso;
blocks.translation: And whirled him round, and dashed him on a rock;

blocks.source: e quella s’annegò con l’altro carco.
blocks.translation: And she, with the other burthen, drowned herself;—

blocks.source: E quando la fortuna volse in basso
blocks.translation: And at the time when fortune downward hurled

blocks.source: l’altezza de’ Troian che tutto ardiva,
blocks.translation: The greatness of the Trojans, who dared all,

blocks.source: sì che ’nsieme col regno il re fu casso,
blocks.translation: So that the king was with his kingdom crushed,

blocks.source: Ecuba trista, misera e cattiva,
blocks.translation: Hecuba sad, disconsolate, and captive,

blocks.source: poscia che vide Polissena morta,
blocks.translation: When lifeless she beheld Polyxena,

blocks.source: e del suo Polidoro in su la riva
blocks.translation: And of her Polydorus on the shore

blocks.source: del mar si fu la dolorosa accorta,
blocks.translation: Of ocean was the dolorous one aware,

blocks.source: forsennata latrò sì come cane;
blocks.translation: Out of her senses like a dog she barked,

blocks.source: tanto il dolor le fé la mente torta.
blocks.translation: So much the anguish had her mind distorted;

blocks.source: Ma né di Tebe furie né troiane
blocks.translation: But not of Thebes the furies nor the Trojan

blocks.source: si vider mäi in alcun tanto crude,
blocks.translation: Were ever seen in any one so cruel

blocks.source: non punger bestie, nonché membra umane,
blocks.translation: In goading beasts, and much more human members,

blocks.source: quant’ io vidi in due ombre smorte e nude,
blocks.translation: As I beheld two shadows pale and naked,

blocks.source: che mordendo correvan di quel modo
blocks.translation: Who, biting, in the manner ran along

blocks.source: che ’l porco quando del porcil si schiude.
blocks.translation: That a boar does, when from the sty turned loose.

blocks.source: L’una giunse a Capocchio, e in sul nodo
blocks.translation: One to Capocchio came, and by the nape

blocks.source: del collo l’assannò, sì che, tirando,
blocks.translation: Seized with its teeth his neck, so that in dragging

blocks.source: grattar li fece il ventre al fondo sodo.
blocks.translation: It made his belly grate the solid bottom.

blocks.source: E l’Aretin che rimase, tremando
blocks.translation: And the Aretine, who trembling had remained,

blocks.source: mi disse: «Quel folletto è Gianni Schicchi,
blocks.translation: Said to me: “That mad sprite is Gianni Schicchi,

blocks.source: e va rabbioso altrui così conciando».
blocks.translation: And raving goes thus harrying other people.”

blocks.source: «Oh», diss’ io lui, «se l’altro non ti ficchi
blocks.translation: “O,” said I to him, “so may not the other

blocks.source: li denti a dosso, non ti sia fatica
blocks.translation: Set teeth on thee, let it not weary thee

blocks.source: a dir chi è, pria che di qui si spicchi».
blocks.translation: To tell us who it is, ere it dart hence.”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «Quell’ è l’anima antica
blocks.translation: And he to me: “That is the ancient ghost

blocks.source: di Mirra scellerata, che divenne
blocks.translation: Of the nefarious Myrrha, who became

blocks.source: al padre, fuor del dritto amore, amica.
blocks.translation: Beyond all rightful love her father’s lover.

blocks.source: Questa a peccar con esso così venne,
blocks.translation: She came to sin with him after this manner,

blocks.source: falsificando sé in altrui forma,
blocks.translation: By counterfeiting of another’s form;

blocks.source: come l’altro che là sen va, sostenne,
blocks.translation: As he who goeth yonder undertook,

blocks.source: per guadagnar la donna de la torma,
blocks.translation: That he might gain the lady of the herd,

blocks.source: falsificare in sé Buoso Donati,
blocks.translation: To counterfeit in himself Buoso Donati,

blocks.source: testando e dando al testamento norma».
blocks.translation: Making a will and giving it due form.”

blocks.source: E poi che i due rabbiosi fuor passati
blocks.translation: And after the two maniacs had passed

blocks.source: sovra cu’ io avea l’occhio tenuto,
blocks.translation: On whom I held mine eye, I turned it back

blocks.source: rivolsilo a guardar li altri mal nati.
blocks.translation: To look upon the other evil-born.

blocks.source: Io vidi un, fatto a guisa di lëuto,
blocks.translation: I saw one made in fashion of a lute,

blocks.source: pur ch’elli avesse avuta l’anguinaia
blocks.translation: If he had only had the groin cut off

blocks.source: tronca da l’altro che l’uomo ha forcuto.
blocks.translation: Just at the point at which a man is forked.

blocks.source: La grave idropesì, che sì dispaia
blocks.translation: The heavy dropsy, that so disproportions

blocks.source: le membra con l’omor che mal converte,
blocks.translation: The limbs with humours, which it ill concocts,

blocks.source: che ’l viso non risponde a la ventraia,
blocks.translation: That the face corresponds not to the belly,

blocks.source: faceva lui tener le labbra aperte
blocks.translation: Compelled him so to hold his lips apart

blocks.source: come l’etico fa, che per la sete
blocks.translation: As does the hectic, who because of thirst

blocks.source: l’un verso ’l mento e l’altro in sù rinverte.
blocks.translation: One tow’rds the chin, the other upward turns.

blocks.source: «O voi che sanz’ alcuna pena siete,
blocks.translation: “O ye, who without any torment are,

blocks.source: e non so io perché, nel mondo gramo»,
blocks.translation: And why I know not, in the world of woe,”

blocks.source: diss’ elli a noi, «guardate e attendete
blocks.translation: He said to us, “behold, and be attentive

blocks.source: a la miseria del maestro Adamo;
blocks.translation: Unto the misery of Master Adam;

blocks.source: io ebbi, vivo, assai di quel ch’i’ volli,
blocks.translation: I had while living much of what I wished,

blocks.source: e ora, lasso!, un gocciol d’acqua bramo.
blocks.translation: And now, alas! a drop of water crave.

blocks.source: Li ruscelletti che d’i verdi colli
blocks.translation: The rivulets, that from the verdant hills

blocks.source: del Casentin discendon giuso in Arno,
blocks.translation: Of Cassentin descend down into Arno,

blocks.source: faccendo i lor canali freddi e molli,
blocks.translation: Making their channels to be cold and moist,

blocks.source: sempre mi stanno innanzi, e non indarno,
blocks.translation: Ever before me stand, and not in vain;

blocks.source: ché l’imagine lor vie più m’asciuga
blocks.translation: For far more doth their image dry me up

blocks.source: che ’l male ond’ io nel volto mi discarno.
blocks.translation: Than the disease which strips my face of flesh.

blocks.source: La rigida giustizia che mi fruga
blocks.translation: The rigid justice that chastises me

blocks.source: tragge cagion del loco ov’ io peccai
blocks.translation: Draweth occasion from the place in which

blocks.source: a metter più li miei sospiri in fuga.
blocks.translation: I sinned, to put the more my sighs in flight.

blocks.source: Ivi è Romena, là dov’ io falsai
blocks.translation: There is Romena, where I counterfeited

blocks.source: la lega suggellata del Batista;
blocks.translation: The currency imprinted with the Baptist,

blocks.source: per ch’io il corpo sù arso lasciai.
blocks.translation: For which I left my body burned above.

blocks.source: Ma s’io vedessi qui l’anima trista
blocks.translation: But if I here could see the tristful soul

blocks.source: di Guido o d’Alessandro o di lor frate,
blocks.translation: Of Guido, or Alessandro, or their brother,

blocks.source: per Fonte Branda non darei la vista.
blocks.translation: For Branda’s fount I would not give the sight.

blocks.source: Dentro c’è l’una già, se l’arrabbiate
blocks.translation: One is within already, if the raving

blocks.source: ombre che vanno intorno dicon vero;
blocks.translation: Shades that are going round about speak truth;

blocks.source: ma che mi val, c’ho le membra legate?
blocks.translation: But what avails it me, whose limbs are tied?

blocks.source: S’io fossi pur di tanto ancor leggero
blocks.translation: If I were only still so light, that in

blocks.source: ch’i’ potessi in cent’ anni andare un’oncia,
blocks.translation: A hundred years I could advance one inch,

blocks.source: io sarei messo già per lo sentiero,
blocks.translation: I had already started on the way,

blocks.source: cercando lui tra questa gente sconcia,
blocks.translation: Seeking him out among this squalid folk,

blocks.source: con tutto ch’ella volge undici miglia,
blocks.translation: Although the circuit be eleven miles,

blocks.source: e men d’un mezzo di traverso non ci ha.
blocks.translation: And be not less than half a mile across.

blocks.source: Io son per lor tra sì fatta famiglia;
blocks.translation: For them am I in such a family;

blocks.source: e’ m’indussero a batter li fiorini
blocks.translation: They did induce me into coining florins,

blocks.source: ch’avevan tre carati di mondiglia».
blocks.translation: Which had three carats of impurity.”

blocks.source: E io a lui: «Chi son li due tapini
blocks.translation: And I to him: “Who are the two poor wretches

blocks.source: che fumman come man bagnate ’l verno,
blocks.translation: That smoke like unto a wet hand in winter,

blocks.source: giacendo stretti a’ tuoi destri confini?».
blocks.translation: Lying there close upon thy right-hand confines?”

blocks.source: «Qui li trovai—e poi volta non dierno—»,
blocks.translation: “I found them here,” replied he, “when I rained

blocks.source: rispuose, «quando piovvi in questo greppo,
blocks.translation: Into this chasm, and since they have not turned,

blocks.source: e non credo che dieno in sempiterno.
blocks.translation: Nor do I think they will for evermore.

blocks.source: L’una è la falsa ch’accusò Gioseppo;
blocks.translation: One the false woman is who accused Joseph,

blocks.source: l’altr’ è ’l falso Sinon greco di Troia:
blocks.translation: The other the false Sinon, Greek of Troy;

blocks.source: per febbre aguta gittan tanto leppo».
blocks.translation: From acute fever they send forth such reek.”

blocks.source: E l’un di lor, che si recò a noia
blocks.translation: And one of them, who felt himself annoyed

blocks.source: forse d’esser nomato sì oscuro,
blocks.translation: At being, peradventure, named so darkly,

blocks.source: col pugno li percosse l’epa croia.
blocks.translation: Smote with the fist upon his hardened paunch.

blocks.source: Quella sonò come fosse un tamburo;
blocks.translation: It gave a sound, as if it were a drum;

blocks.source: e mastro Adamo li percosse il volto
blocks.translation: And Master Adam smote him in the face,

blocks.source: col braccio suo, che non parve men duro,
blocks.translation: With arm that did not seem to be less hard,

blocks.source: dicendo a lui: «Ancor che mi sia tolto
blocks.translation: Saying to him: “Although be taken from me

blocks.source: lo muover per le membra che son gravi,
blocks.translation: All motion, for my limbs that heavy are,

blocks.source: ho io il braccio a tal mestiere sciolto».
blocks.translation: I have an arm unfettered for such need.”

blocks.source: Ond’ ei rispuose: «Quando tu andavi
blocks.translation: Whereat he answer made: “When thou didst go

blocks.source: al fuoco, non l’avei tu così presto;
blocks.translation: Unto the fire, thou hadst it not so ready:

blocks.source: ma sì e più l’avei quando coniavi».
blocks.translation: But hadst it so and more when thou wast coining.”

blocks.source: E l’idropico: «Tu di’ ver di questo:
blocks.translation: The dropsical: “Thou sayest true in that;

blocks.source: ma tu non fosti sì ver testimonio
blocks.translation: But thou wast not so true a witness there,

blocks.source: là ’ve del ver fosti a Troia richesto».
blocks.translation: Where thou wast questioned of the truth at Troy.”

blocks.source: «S’io dissi falso, e tu falsasti il conio»,
blocks.translation: “If I spake false, thou falsifiedst the coin,”

blocks.source: disse Sinon; «e son qui per un fallo,
blocks.translation: Said Sinon; “and for one fault I am here,

blocks.source: e tu per più ch’alcun altro demonio!».
blocks.translation: And thou for more than any other demon.”

blocks.source: «Ricorditi, spergiuro, del cavallo»,
blocks.translation: “Remember, perjurer, about the horse,”

blocks.source: rispuose quel ch’avëa infiata l’epa;
blocks.translation: He made reply who had the swollen belly,

blocks.source: «e sieti reo che tutto il mondo sallo!».
blocks.translation: “And rueful be it thee the whole world knows it.”

blocks.source: «E te sia rea la sete onde ti crepa»,
blocks.translation: “Rueful to thee the thirst be wherewith cracks

blocks.source: disse ’l Greco, «la lingua, e l’acqua marcia
blocks.translation: Thy tongue,” the Greek said, “and the putrid water

blocks.source: che ’l ventre innanzi a li occhi sì t’assiepa!».
blocks.translation: That hedges so thy paunch before thine eyes.”

blocks.source: Allora il monetier: «Così si squarcia
blocks.translation: Then the false-coiner: “So is gaping wide

blocks.source: la bocca tua per tuo mal come suole;
blocks.translation: Thy mouth in pain, as it is wont to do;

blocks.source: ché, s’i’ ho sete e omor mi rinfarcia,
blocks.translation: Because if I have thirst, and humour stuff me

blocks.source: tu hai l’arsura e ’l capo che ti duole,
blocks.translation: Thou hast the burning and the head that aches,

blocks.source: e per leccar lo specchio di Narcisso,
blocks.translation: And to lick up the mirror of Narcissus

blocks.source: non vorresti a ’nvitar molte parole».
blocks.translation: Thou wouldst not want words many to invite thee.”

blocks.source: Ad ascoltarli er’ io del tutto fisso,
blocks.translation: In listening to them was I wholly fixed,

blocks.source: quando ’l maestro mi disse: «Or pur mira,
blocks.translation: When said the Master to me: “Now just look,

blocks.source: che per poco che teco non mi risso!».
blocks.translation: For little wants it that I quarrel with thee.”

blocks.source: Quand’ io ’l senti’ a me parlar con ira,
blocks.translation: When him I heard in anger speak to me,

blocks.source: volsimi verso lui con tal vergogna,
blocks.translation: I turned me round towards him with such shame

blocks.source: ch’ancor per la memoria mi si gira.
blocks.translation: That still it eddies through my memory.

blocks.source: Qual è colui che suo dannaggio sogna,
blocks.translation: And as he is who dreams of his own harm,

blocks.source: che sognando desidera sognare,
blocks.translation: Who dreaming wishes it may be a dream,

blocks.source: sì che quel ch’è, come non fosse, agogna,
blocks.translation: So that he craves what is, as if it were not;

blocks.source: tal mi fec’ io, non possendo parlare,
blocks.translation: Such I became, not having power to speak,

blocks.source: che disïava scusarmi, e scusava
blocks.translation: For to excuse myself I wished, and still

blocks.source: me tuttavia, e nol mi credea fare.
blocks.translation: Excused myself, and did not think I did it.

blocks.source: «Maggior difetto men vergogna lava»,
blocks.translation: “Less shame doth wash away a greater fault,”

blocks.source: disse ’l maestro, «che ’l tuo non è stato;
blocks.translation: The Master said, “than this of thine has been;

blocks.source: però d’ogne trestizia ti disgrava.
blocks.translation: Therefore thyself disburden of all sadness,

blocks.source: E fa ragion ch’io ti sia sempre allato,
blocks.translation: And make account that I am aye beside thee,

blocks.source: se più avvien che fortuna t’accoglia
blocks.translation: If e’er it come to pass that fortune bring thee

blocks.source: dove sien genti in simigliante piato:
blocks.translation: Where there are people in a like dispute;

blocks.source: ché voler ciò udire è bassa voglia».
blocks.translation: For a base wish it is to wish to hear it.”
